description: §61.2/§61.7 — an `<endpoint>` carrying the per-endpoint `cors=` attribute (a string literal origin) is a valid declaration: `cors-attr ::= 'cors=' string-literal` is part of `endpoint-attrs`. The run-time half (a preflight answered 204 with that origin only; 405 without `cors=`; program `cors=` not applying to the endpoint, §39.2.1) is served-HTTP behavior the case schema cannot drive — it is proven by compiler/tests/integration/endpoint-cors-served.test.js.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — program `cors=` does not cover `<endpoint>` routes; per-endpoint `cors=` (S479, 2026-11-18)"
rationale: §61.7: "An `<endpoint>` MAY carry `cors=`, a string literal with the values of the §39.2.1 program attribute".
